newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangzhou ship not in restructure talks.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou ship not in restructure talks.

text.p: Guangzhou Shipyard International Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was not in talks with its parent or other parties regarding a group restructuring.

"There are no negotiations or agreements between the company and China State Shipbuilding Corporation, the controlling shareholder of the company, or any other third parties in relation to the reorganisation of the assets of the company," the company said in a statement.
Guangzhou Shipyard said there were no changes in the company's management, including the directors.
Trading in the company shares was suspended on Tuesday and was due to resume on Wednesday. The stock soared 29.8 percent to HK$2.725 prior to the trading suspension on Tuesday.
